correctness.rationale: For the connected undirected weighted graph and positive κ_j for j≠ℓ, M=L+K_0 is positive definite, u=M^{-1}eℓ cannot be constant, and H=L+I−11ᵀ/n is positive semidefinite with kernel constants, so g=uℓ>0 and C=uᵀHu>0. Substitution proves x(t)=x0+(sℓ−(x0)ℓ)η(t)u, η=t/(1+gt), and PD(t)=x0ᵀHx0+2dBη+d²Cη². If d=0 it is constant; otherwise strictly convex as a function of η. Projection of −B/(dC) onto [0,1/g] and inversion gives exact finite, boundary and t→∞ infimum cases; 0<η*<1/g iff unique strict finite interior minimum. Independent rational algebra on the 3-vertex path checked PD(t)=3(21t²+6t+5)/[4(5t+3)²], derivative 24(3t−1)/(5t+3)^3, minimizer 1/3 and PD=9/28. These finite checks corroborate the general rank-one and strict-curvature proof.
